Frequently Asked Questions

This is a new generation of glass-ceramic that protects both the front and back of the phone. It features an Apple-designed coating that is 3x more scratch-resistant and significantly reduces glare, which is especially helpful for outdoor use in high-sunlight regions like Pakistan.

The 17 Pro Max marks the debut of the Apple N1 networking chip. This in-house silicon manages Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6.0, and Thread, offering more stable connections and lower battery drain than the older Broadcom chips.

To keep the A19 Pro chip running at peak speeds, Apple introduced a laser-welded vapor chamber. This system uses a tiny amount of liquid to dissipate heat 40% more effectively than previous graphite sheets, which is vital for AAA gaming and 4K120 video editing.

By combining a new 48MP telephoto sensor with advanced "tetraprism" optics, the Pro Max delivers 8x optical-quality zoom. It effectively replaces the need for multiple zoom lenses by using high-resolution sensor cropping to bridge the gap between 1x and 8x.

For the first time, all three rear lenses Main, Ultra-Wide, and Telephoto—use 48MP sensors. This allows you to shoot 48MP ProRAW photos at any focal length, providing incredible detail even when zooming in post-production.

The screen has grown to a massive 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR OLED. Despite the larger size, the phone feels similar in hand to the 16 Pro Max because Apple used "Border Reduction Structure" (BRS) technology to create the thinnest bezels on any smartphone.

iPhone 17 Pro Max Price in Pakistan

iPhone 17 Pro Max — Maximum power. Maximum Pro.

Overview

The iPhone 17 Pro Max is Apple’s most advanced iPhone, built for users who want the biggest display, longest battery life, and highest level of performance available in the iPhone lineup. Designed by Apple, it combines premium materials, cutting-edge performance, and a professional camera system into one flagship device.

Whether you create content, multitask throughout the day, or simply want the best iPhone experience Apple offers, the iPhone 17 Pro Max is designed to deliver at every level.

Available in Pakistan through applemac.pk with fast nationwide delivery.

Performance

At the core of the iPhone 17 Pro Max is the A19 Pro chip, engineered for exceptional speed, efficiency, and graphics performance. It features a 6-core CPU, advanced GPU performance, and a 16-core Neural Engine designed to power intelligent features and demanding workflows.

This allows the iPhone 17 Pro Max to handle professional video editing, console-level gaming, multitasking, and intensive apps with ease. It is built to stay fast and responsive not only today, but for years to come.

Apple Intelligence is integrated into the experience, helping users communicate, organise, and create more efficiently while keeping privacy at the centre.

Design and Build

The iPhone 17 Pro Max features a refined premium design made with high-quality materials for strength, durability, and elegance. Every edge and surface is engineered with precision to create a device that feels substantial and premium in hand.

The front is protected by Ceramic Shield for added durability, while the overall construction is built to withstand everyday use. It is also rated IP68 for water and dust resistance, providing added peace of mind against splashes, spills, and exposure.

Available finishes vary by market and release.

Display

The iPhone 17 Pro Max features a 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR display, the largest display in the iPhone 17 lineup. It delivers a bright, immersive, and incredibly sharp viewing experience ideal for productivity, gaming, streaming, and content creation.

With ProMotion technology, the refresh rate adapts up to 120Hz for ultra-smooth scrolling and responsiveness. The display also includes Always-On display, Dynamic Island, HDR support, True Tone, and wide colour for a rich visual experience.

Whether indoors or outdoors, the display is engineered to remain clear, vivid, and highly usable.

Camera System

The iPhone 17 Pro Max includes Apple’s most advanced Pro camera system, designed for users who want professional-level photography and video performance directly from their phone.

It features a high-resolution main camera, ultra-wide camera, and telephoto system for versatile shooting across a wide range of focal lengths. From landscapes and portraits to zoom shots and macro photography, the camera system is built to capture stunning detail and accurate colour.

Advanced imaging technologies such as Night mode, Smart HDR, Deep Fusion, and Apple’s image processing help deliver consistent results in all lighting conditions.

For creators, the iPhone 17 Pro Max supports professional-grade video features, including high-resolution recording, cinematic effects, stabilisation, and advanced editing workflows.

Battery Life

Battery life is one of the biggest strengths of the iPhone 17 Pro Max. It is built to deliver the longest battery performance in the iPhone lineup, allowing users to work, stream, create, and stay connected throughout the day.

It supports fast charging for quick top-ups, along with convenient wireless charging options, including MagSafe compatibility.

For users who need endurance without compromise, the Pro Max model is the best choice.

Storage Options

The iPhone 17 Pro Max is available in multiple storage capacities to match different needs, from everyday users to professionals who store large photo libraries and video projects.

Higher storage options are ideal for creators, mobile professionals, and users who want maximum long-term flexibility.

Connectivity and Features

The iPhone 17 Pro Max includes advanced connectivity features for fast and reliable performance, whether on mobile networks or wireless connections.

It integrates seamlessly with Apple’s ecosystem, making it easy to move between devices, share files, and continue tasks across products.

Security features such as Face ID help protect your data, while emergency and safety tools add extra peace of mind.

iPhone 17 Pro Max vs iPhone 17 Pro

The iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPhone 17 Pro share the same professional-level performance and advanced feature set, but the Pro Max offers two major advantages: a larger display and longer battery life.

Users who prefer a more compact Pro device may choose the iPhone 17 Pro, while those who want the most immersive screen and maximum battery endurance should choose the iPhone 17 Pro Max.

If you want the absolute best iPhone experience available, the Pro Max stands at the top.

Who Should Buy the iPhone 17 Pro Max?

The iPhone 17 Pro Max is ideal for:

  • Content creators and videographers
  • Mobile gamers
  • Business professionals
  • Users who multitask heavily
  • Anyone who wants the biggest screen and best battery life
  • Customers who want Apple’s top-tier flagship model
